judgement: The training and prediction pipeline works, but the 9-row dataset cannot represent the nonlinear electrothermal response accurately enough for design decisions.

next_data_requirement.recommended_sampling: Use at least 7 voltage levels and 7 heat-transfer-coefficient levels, with denser points near high-voltage/high-temperature conditions.
next_data_requirement.validation: Keep at least 20% of COMSOL runs as unseen holdout cases.
